notes: Source: official Samsung QMR Series UHD Commercial Displays spec sheet (DIGSIG-QMRSERIESDSHT-MAY19T, samsung.com/b2bdigitalsignage), which includes a rear-panel connectivity diagram common to the QM43R/49R/55R/65R/75R models. Port list and numbering (1-13) taken directly from that diagram. HDMI In 1 supports ARC; HDMI In 2 and DP In are labeled "Daisy Chain In" and HDMI Out is "Daisy Chain Out" for video-wall daisy-chaining (HDCP 2.2: 4 displays, HDCP 1.4: 7 displays). DVI/MagicInfo In (port 4) is a DVI-D input also usable for MagicInfo; port 10 is a stereo mini-jack analog audio input shared for DVI/HDMI audio; port 11 is a stereo mini-jack audio output. RS232C In/Out are stereo (TRS 3.5mm) jacks per the spec table ("RS232C (In/Out) thru Stereo Jack"), not DE-9 — modeled as trs-3.5 connector accepting rs232 signal since trs-3.5 is the physical jack. IR In (port 13) is a physical mini-jack IR sensor input. AC power inlet type is not explicitly stated as IEC in the spec sheet (listed only as "Power Type: Internal", AC 100-240V, with a "Power Cord" included accessory) — inferred as IEC C13/C14 based on standard practice for commercial displays in this power class (231W max); could not directly confirm the exact power inlet connector, so treat that one port with medium confidence. Also applies to the QM75R-A refresh (bhphotovideo.com listing) which appears to share the same I/O layout; minor variant differences across regions (e.g. -B suffix) not confirmed.
